method: Geo-seq AP/PD rank programme spatial field interpolation with a fixed 15-neighbor-scale locality cost; within-state capacity-constrained pairing represented as inverse coordinate permutation
external_sources: GSE65924 E7.0 epiblast Geo-seq, three independent replicates
GSE278981/GSM8559288 independent E7.25 PE725 counts, inherited solely through fixed v0021 parent
disclosure: External data: GSE65924, three independent E7.0 epiblast Geo-seq replicates, cross-replicate stable AP/PD gene rank priors only; no absolute FPKM, inferred atlas embeddings, or fabricated physical coordinates transferred. Parent v0021 additionally uses GSE278981/GSM8559288 independent E7.25 PE725 10x sample-specific count files to learn gene rank dependence; no E7.5 files or joint atlas models. Official released E6.75/E7.25/E8.0 embryo data only; no protected validation/test labels. No pretrained models.
limitations: Local programme coupling is stronger than shuffled-gene control but does not improve on the untouched copula parent; this is a server hypothesis test, not a claimed gain.
Coordinate multiset invariance does not guarantee invariant finite-index subsampled shape skills.
Geo-seq pools are E7.0 epiblast and not single-cell target anatomy; coarse programmes omit other spatial dimensions.
Parent is fixed byte-exact v0021; programme scores and pairing are recomputed on its actual X, not copied from E3.
budget: fourth and final planned slot, external second of two; unsubmitted at freeze
